text: Election of the Vice-Chair of the Toronto Realty Agency under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office ending November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
The Toronto Realty Agency: 1. Elected Councillor David Shiner as Vice-Chair of the Toronto Realty Agency for a term of office ending November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
